messages:
June (Design): quick flag: on mobile narrow widths the kebab menu on Model List gets partially covered by success toasts. saw it on iOS Safari and Android Chrome.
Rafi - Eng: can you share a repro gif? which page exactly?
June (Design): Dashboard -> Models -> Actions -> Deploy -> hit 'Schedule' then confirm. success toast pops bottom-right and the kebab's menu appears under it. attaching tiny gif.
Elena (Design Systems): suspected cause: compact spacing tokens reduced button padding and our popper instance is positioned with `transform` parent so its z-order gets stuck below fixed toasts. Also touch-targets are effectively <44px for compact buttons.
Tobias (PM): user impact: users may think the action didn't trigger if they can't tap the menu item cleanly. also toast copy "Saved" is ambiguous here.
June (Design): proposed fixes: 1) introduce `--touch-target-min` = 44px and make compact aliases preserve it, 2) make toasts avoid overlapping open popovers/dropdowns by default, 3) for small viewports (<420px) center toasts horizontally to avoid right-side flyouts.
Rafi - Eng: implementation notes: quick workaround: `pointer-events: none` on toasts when a popper is open, but that prevents undo actions. better to have toasts reposition using Popper.js with an avoid-rect plugin. also we can set `will-change: auto` instead of transform on the table wrapper to avoid creating stacking context.
Elena (Design Systems): also add an accessibility rule: focus-visible elements get a higher stacking context than toasts so keyboard users don't get obscured.
Tobias (PM): copy suggestion: change "Saved" -> "Version saved" for this flow. include the item name when available.
toasts-bot: opened PR `toast-popover-avoid` with preview https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/2400 :eyes:
Rafi - Eng: tested PR on staging (320px, 375px). popovers are now above toasts, touch targets look less cramped. left screenshots. still seeing a very brief overlap during toast entrance animation; will shorten enter duration to 150ms and toggle pointer-events after animation.
June (Design): sounds good. add a Percy snapshot for 320/375 widths to catch regressions. also document the `--touch-target-min` token in the tokens README.
Elena (Design Systems): will add lint rule to prevent tokens that result in hit areas <44px and update compact token set.
Tobias (PM): adding to release notes: "Improved toast positioning to prevent overlap with menus and improve touch interactions on mobile."
June (Design): thanks team, merging once CI passes.
